source_definitions.277: Lemma1.8: C_0=C′; C_i contains the terms of short exact sequences with two terms in C_{i−1}, in the abelian branch.
source_definitions.278: Exercise1.9: A is a full subcategory of abelian C, stable under finite sums, subobjects and quotients, with Ob A dense in Ob C; the hint starts A=A_0.

comparison: The entire exercise1.9 statement and its hint prose are plain. Only Hint has a lexical lower rule; its colon is outside the rule. The section heading retains accepted heading typography, while the number2.1 and all four notation descriptions are plain.
